title: HTX Live Guarded Spot Preconditions
description: Contract suite for future HTX live spot support. It documents the safety gate without enabling live trading.

program.supportedDecision: Decide whether a future live HTX spot adapter satisfies the minimum safety contract.

dataset.labelingProcess: Each scenario requires explicit evidence that live trading is disabled unless the opt-in flag, allowlist, caps, and human approval are present.
dataset.versioning: Keep ids stable while live spot remains guarded.

judges.description: Check that live spot remains disabled by default and that all required guardrail artifacts are present before any future live order.

releaseGates.description: Block release if any scenario enables live HTX spot trading by default.

steps.objective: Show that HTX live spot order placement is unavailable unless OMNI_AGENT_ENABLE_LIVE_HTX_SPOT=1 is explicitly set.
Require symbol allowlist, quote cap, order preview, risk report, human approval, and post-order status evidence before any future live HTX spot order.
